subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the focused fresh-session bug fix while keeping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200 as follow-up, or should it pause and be expanded into reattach-first recovery before merge?
rationale: The code path is narrow and source-backed, but it intentionally preserves duplicate execution across gateway and local fallback sessions; only maintainers can choose that product/merge-risk boundary.

options.title: Land focused fix now
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary, merge the same-session protection after normal maintainer/CI refresh, and leave reattach-first recovery to the linked follow-up.

options.title: Expand before merge
options.body: Ask the author to fold reattach-first wait/recovery into this PR, reducing duplicate side effects at the cost of a larger stdout/streaming behavior change.

options.title: Pause for direction
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader disconnect behavior is decided, leaving current main exposed to the same-session duplicate edge case meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary, merge the same-session protection after normal maintainer/CI refresh, and leave reattach-first recovery to the linked follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits show this person closest to the `agent-via-gateway` command surface and the current-main recipient-session behavior that the merge ref preserves.
